identity.title: Survey Observations of a Possible Glycine Precursor, Methanimine (CH2NH)

paper_type_evidence.quote: We conducted survey observations of a glycine precursor, methanimine or methylenimine (CH$_2$NH), with the NRO 45 m telescope and the SMT telescope towards 12 high-mass and two low-mass star-forming regions
We investigated the distribution of the CH$_2$NH 1$_{1 1}$-0$_{ 0 0}$ transition at 225.55455 GHz towards Orion KL using the calibrated Science Verification data of ALMA cycle 0

question.value: Which star-forming regions show CH2NH, what distinguishes CH2NH-rich sources, and how is CH2NH formed (gas phase vs dust surface)?

evidence.quote: in order to increase number of CH$_2$NH sources and to better understand the characteristics of CH$_2$NH sources.

results_numeric.quantity: Upper limit desorption temperature of CH2NH

findings_qualitative.value: CH2NH detected in eight sources including four new; rich sources have less evolved HII regions

evidence.quote: CH$_2$NH was detected in eight sources, including four new sources.

claims.hypothesis: CH2NH is mainly gas-phase formed rather than evaporated
claims.result: dust-surface CH2NH is <1e-12, NH + CH3 dominant

evidence.quote: CH$_2$NH in the hot sources seems to have been formed in the gas-phase rather than evaporated from the ices.

claims.hypothesis: CH2NH richness is tied to HII region evolution
claims.finding: less evolved HII regions in CH2NH-rich sources

evidence.quote: Our results suggest that top three CH$_2$NH-rich sources would possess less evolved HII regions

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Distance and temperature differences rejected as explanations

evidence.quote: temperature differences among hot core sources could not explain our observational results.

limitations_admitted.value: Large error in G31.41+0.3 abundance due to scatter in rotation diagram

evidence.quote: The large error of the fractional abundance in G31.41+0.3 is due to scattering of the plots in its rotation diagram
